set.body:
Owner: fmri-workflow/dataset/model; consumer revision and job policy remains PLS Neuro. Consumer W1 bd-01M1YVQ3V8ESWPJAYHQFQ3S6GT and W0 FirstLevelWorkbenchProbe. Source evidence: FirstLevelUnitDataset.open binds tables then calls FirstLevelUnitSource.open and opens the dataset before model compilation; gzip staging can expand the entire BOLD input. Separately, PLS Neuro BidsFirstLevelSession.prepare captures all selected input digests including BOLD before and after preparation. A preview therefore is not metadata/table-only, even though it does not fit coefficients.
Provide a public way to compile a scientifically identical model from a reviewed acquisition description, sample grid, mask/geometry and companion tables without materializing BOLD responses. Bind the eventual reader/fit to the same reviewed acquisition/model identities. Do not fabricate in-memory zero response arrays or duplicate model building in the client. Headers and explicitly required masks/tables may be read; full BOLD decompression/payload reads must be deferred. Distinguish provisional metadata-based preview identity from full content-verified fit identity and refuse changed inputs at execution. PLS Neuro separately defers bulk digest work out of interactive preview without weakening its final fitting boundary.
Acceptance: instrumented public beta/FIR preview on compressed and uncompressed data proves no BOLD payload reads/staging; changing onsets, TR, selection, nuisance, mask/geometry invalidates the correct revision; final execution verifies content and agrees with ordinary public plans/fits. Shared JVM+JS model/binding tests and JVM source/staging/cancellation tests. Coordinate optional QC review issue bd-01M1Z1KMBH5Y0F9G2G9CNN6KK8. Implementation remains open.
set.title: First-level preview: compile designs without materializing BOLD responses
